checks.cadence: daily or before any governed build
checks.failureRoute: Stop governed work and reconcile current authority or contract drift.
Do not hand off or assemble a candidate.

checks.cadence: every candidate assembly and before human review
checks.failureRoute: Block PORT-04, invalidate the affected candidate approval and assemble a new version through a new bounded review; never rebuild approved rc.2 in place.

checks.cadence: quarterly or after a major identity, component or release decision
checks.failureRoute: Open a bounded audit task; never silently rewrite canonical values.

note: This file defines the governed cadence. It does not create an external scheduler or grant mutation authority.
